findings_nit_open: R-1 (nit, axis 3): defaultTemplateRenderer uses html=false; EmailChannelDriver (T-0170) receives pre-rendered job.body (text: field). If/when HTML email bodies are introduced, caller must call renderNotification(..., {html:true}) separately before SMTP. Documented in code comment. Follow-up: 'HTML email render path' task when HTML email transition occurs in E-N roadmap.
R-2 (nit, axis 4): No explicit test for fullwidth Unicode lookalike chars (U+FF1C ＜, U+FF1E ＞). Not a security gap — HTML parsers do not interpret fullwidth as tags. Osознанно not a threat. Deferred.

residual_risks.description: HTML email render path: defaultTemplateRenderer uses html=false (plain-text). EmailChannelDriver (T-0170) receives pre-rendered job.body via outbox — it uses text: job.body (SMTP text part). If HTML email bodies are introduced in E-N.x, the email channel must call renderNotification(..., {html:true}) before building the SMTP message — not use defaultTemplateRenderer directly. Gap is safe for day-1 (no HTML email today). Code comment documents the expectation. Follow-up task needed at HTML email transition.
residual_risks.follow_up_candidate: Create task 'E-N.x HTML email render path: EmailChannelDriver calls renderNotification({html:true}) for HTML SMTP bodies'. Triggers when HTML email bodies are introduced.

residual_risks.description: No explicit test for fullwidth Unicode lookalike chars (U+FF1C ＜ / U+FF1E ＞) documenting they are not HTML-dangerous. HTML parsers do not interpret fullwidth as tags — this is osознанно not a security gap. An explicit test would make the decision auditable in the test suite.
residual_risks.follow_up_candidate: Add: it('escapeHtml: fullwidth < and > are not HTML-dangerous, not escaped', () => { expect(escapeHtml('＜script＞')).toBe('＜script＞'); }); — nit-sweep candidate.

architecture_notes.pure_core: notification-templates.ts is pure-function: no pg, no http, no eval, no LLM. Zero runtime deps except type imports. Testable without DATABASE_URL.
architecture_notes.dead_wiring: defaultTemplateRenderer is exported and implements TemplateRendererPort but is not yet wired into publishNotificationEvent in production. This is known-acceptable dead-wiring (analogous to T-0171 PostgresPrefStore). Full production wiring falls on E-N.6/E-N.7 per spec §5 out-of-scope.
architecture_notes.template_sync: NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATES (5 entries) exactly matches T-0171 DEFAULT_PREFERENCES event_kinds. task.assigned body uses simplified form (no optional conditional section) — permitted per spec §4 coder-note.
architecture_notes.xss_barrier: escapeHtml: 5 chars, & first (no double-encode). html=true required for any HTML email rendering. html=false plain-text: verbatim output — correct for SMTP text: part and in-app channels.
